hero.title: About SRL Logistics & Holdings
hero.subtitle: We are a multi-service company dedicated to helping businesses operate smarter, move faster, and grow with confidence. From the warehouse floor to the cloud server, we have you covered.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: SRL Logistics & Holdings was founded with a simple vision: businesses shouldn't need a dozen vendors to handle their logistics, IT infrastructure, and software needs. We built a company that brings it all together.

What started as a transportation logistics company has grown into a full-service partner offering cloud hosting, email and domain management, and custom software development — all backed by the same commitment to reliability and client success.

Currently we serve clients across industries, helping them streamline operations, reduce costs, and focus on what they do best. Ministry of Environment, Climate Change, Disaster Management and Meteorological services are developing their Waste Management System Database Portal with us.
